# ErosUI adaptation

This directory contains ErosUI source distributed under the MIT license.
Copyright (c) 2026 Eros001377. The original license is preserved in LICENSE.

Displaced embeds the Common sources into ViperACR.dll. Adaptations include
PromeRotation API bindings, VPR settings callbacks, navigation and extension
settings, saved QT defaults, and rotation lifecycle integration. The upstream
README describes the general framework; the root README documents this package.
